boundary: UNATTRIBUTED means the file is in the diff and was not written through the instrumented surface. It does NOT mean concealment: a formatter, a package manager, a code generator or a merge writes files no agent claimed and none of that is dishonest. This comparison carries no verdict and blocks nothing.
not_measured: the precision of UNATTRIBUTED as a signal has never been measured by a blind panel; only its noise floor is known
